model_annotation: The chart displays the distribution of certain linguistic structures, presenting two related pie charts that break down the data into distinct categories. The larger pie chart on the left is divided into two slices, with the blue slice labeled "双音形容词+单音名词" (101 instances, 30.61%) and the yellow slice labeled "单音形容词+单音名词" (229 instances, 69.39%). The chart on the right, which appears to be a subset of the yellow slice from the left chart, is also divided into two slices: an orange slice labeled "'的' 字节隐不现" (81.66%) and a green slice labeled "'的' 字节现不隐" (18.34%). A legend is provided at the bottom, featuring three colored squares corresponding to the colors used in the charts, although the third color is not utilized in the visible charts. The percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and the slices are not visually emphasized. The two charts are connected by a line, indicating that the right chart is a further breakdown of the yellow slice from the left chart.
